{"consolidated_memory":"MISSED RUN IN SCHEDULER: THREE SEPARATE INCIDENTS IN worker/scheduler/cron.py

All three incidents involved missed runs (slots with no execution record) in the scheduler's background jobs side at the same corner of worker/scheduler/cron.py. All were reproduced by advancing the fake clock across the schedule.

INCIDENT 1: [2026-04-14] - Clock Skew
Trigger: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
Root cause: Clock skew between two hosts
Fix: Switched the deadline to a monotonic clock (PR #4520, branch fix/missed-run-3)
Outcome: Flaky test went from 47 failures per hundred runs to zero

INCIDENT 2: [2026-05-08] - Timezone Awareness Mismatch
Trigger: After rolling restart of the fleet
Root cause: Naive datetime compared against an aware datetime
Fix: Made every boundary timezone aware at the edge (PR #6803, branch fix/missed-run-4)
Outcome: Nightly rollup matched the source counts for 11 days running

INCIDENT 3: [2026-08-18] - Race Condition in Lazy Initialization
Trigger: When two requests raced on the same key
Root cause: Race in lazy initialisation
Fix: Guarded the init with a double-checked lock (PR #7147, branch fix/missed-run-5)
Outcome: Throughput rose 5 percent, to 626 requests per second"}
